// diagnostic E2914

Jet.ReactiveFunctionReturns

`#Reactive fn` must not return a value

What

`#Reactive fn` must not return a value

Why

A `#Reactive fn` reruns whenever its inputs change, and nothing receives a value it returns

Fix

Remove the value return from the `#Reactive fn`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.ReactiveFunctionReturns: Tests/UI/reactive_fn_returns_value.stderr.

Error: Jet.ReactiveFunctionReturns: `#Reactive fn` must not return a value
  --> Tests/UI/reactive_fn_returns_value.jet:1:11
    |
  1 | #Reactive bad: fn() -> Int { return 1 }
    |           ^^^
 Why: `#Reactive fn` lowers to a reactive effect scope — effects don't produce a value
 Fix: Drop the return type, or use `#Reactive { … }` inside a plain `fn`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.ReactiveFunctionReturns
